name: Harenchi Gakuen
source:
A student transfers in a formerly girls school only to find strange rules governing there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-march-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名学生转入一所由女子学校改制而来的校园，却发现这里施行着种种古怪校规。
